newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices rise on low new crops fears.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices rise on low new crops fears.

text.p: Indian castorseed March delivery prices on Thursday recovered to 1,176/1,177 rupees per quintal from 1,167/1,168 rupees on lower than expected new crop arrivals and fears of a poor new crops, dealers said.
"Arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region is 20-22,000 bags (75 kg each) daily while it was 35-40,000 bags a year ago," one operator said.
Groundnut oil gained to 343/344 rupees per 10 kg from 340/341 rupees on fresh physical buying ahead of Hindu festivals.
In Rajkot spot oil was steady at 520/525 rupees per 15 kg.
